exit_criteria: phase-1 goal, boundaries, non-goals, and prototype-only appetite are locked for downstream consumption
desktop screenshot, mobile screenshot, and observed page text are available for AS-IS traceability
UNIT-1 acceptance criteria cover login switching, renewal prompt, download, support, announcement, and responsive behavior
static prototype implementation surface and prototype_only/not_integrated integration boundary are selected
browser obligations cover all six acceptance criteria across desktop and mobile viewports
prototype files exist under phase-1/prototype and developer-report.json records RED/GREEN/REFACTOR plus real-browser evidence notes
review result confirms T1 scope, prototype boundary, and acceptance mapping after developer output exists
verify-result.json independently proves T1 acceptance targets and allowed-path boundary
qa-result.json and desktop/mobile browser evidence prove the six UNIT-1 acceptance criteria without Mock-based acceptance
fresh consistency audit consumes product, design, tasks, developer, review, verify, and QA artifacts after QA evidence exists
delivery-state and signoff-package are produced only after audit, QA, verify, review, and developer prerequisites are satisfied

developer_dispatch.purpose: Implement the static homepage entry center prototype and write the developer-report evidence package only.

blocking_gap_policy.rule: Blocking gaps remain blockers owned by their downstream role; they must not be converted into developer scope.
blocking_gap_policy.developer_scope_boundary: T1 may only change phase-1/prototype/** and phase-1/unit-1/tasks/T1/developer-report.json.

handoff.to_developer: Consume T1 only; preserve prototype_only/not_integrated boundary and do not add backend, auth, payment, download, support, announcement, telemetry, release, or rollback integration.
handoff.to_review: Start after developer-report exists and apply review/fix/re-review before verify.
handoff.to_verify: Start after review closure; verify from canonical task, test-cases, prototype files, and developer-report.
handoff.to_qa: Start after verify; use real browser evidence for desktop and mobile acceptance.
handoff.to_delivery_owner: Do not sign off until QA evidence and fresh consistency audit close downstream blockers.
